[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. **Jamaican Jerk BBQ Sauce**: Ingredients include 1/2 cup ketchup, 1/4 cup jerk seasoning, 2 tablespoons allspice, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon lime juice, and 1 teaspoon scotch bonnet peppers (minced, optional).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. **Smoky Chipotle BBQ Sauce**: Ingredients include 1/2 cup ketchup, 1/4 cup chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, and 1 teaspoon garlic powder.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. **Honey Bourbon BBQ Sauce**: Ingredients include 1/2 cup ketchup, 1/4 cup honey, 2 tablespoons bourbon whiskey, 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, and 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. **Alabama White BBQ Sauce**: Ingredients include 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar, 2 tablespoons ketchup, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, and 1 teaspoon garlic powder.
